items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Adds AI Inference Silicon With Taalas Acquisition
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) agreed to acquire Toronto-based AI chip startup Taalas, aiming to deepen its AI inference offerings. The deal brings Taalas' specialized inference-focused silicon into AMD's product roadmap for enterprise and cloud AI workloads. Taalas' engineering team is expected to join AMD and work on system-level AI inference solutions across future AMD platforms.
